title: Costco barely profits on groceries — and that's the whole plan

beats.narration: Costco barely makes a profit selling you groceries — and that is completely on purpose.
It marks up most products just enough to cover its costs, sometimes almost nothing at all.
The real money comes from the membership fee you pay just to walk in the door.
Over 75 million households pay about 65 dollars a year, and more than 90% renew.
That fee is almost pure profit, and it funds the low prices that keep you coming back.
You're not really the customer — the membership is the product. Follow for more.
